fusions.name: Swarm Upon It
fusions.desc: Sends a knot of locusts into the first enemy it meets, dealing 9 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Stripping Cloud
fusions.desc: Breathes out a cloud of locusts that deals 6 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you. It holds 4 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

fusions.name: Chittering Tide
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a swarm for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
